On November 12, 2026, QXO, Inc. (the “ Company ”) announced the appointment of Dev Ahuja as the Company’s Chief Financial Officer, effective as of his anticipated start date in January 2027. Mr. Ahuja will succeed Ihsan Essaid, who has served as the Company’s Chief Financial Officer since July 2024. On Mr. Ahuja’s start date, Mr. Essaid will be promoted to the Company’s Vice Chairman, an executive role, overseeing mergers and acquisitions and advancing capital-raising activities. Mr. Ahuja, age 61, brings more than two decades of experience leading financial operations for growth-oriented companies. He joins the Company from Novelis Inc. (“ Novelis ”), a leading producer of innovative aluminum solutions, where he has served as Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer since 2016. Previously, with healthcare giant Novartis AG, he held Chief Financial Officer roles for Alcon North America, Alcon Japan, and the company’s South Korean business. No family relationships exist between Mr. Ahuja and any director or executive officer of the Company. There are no arrangements or understandings pursuant to which Mr. Ahuja was selected as an officer and no transactions to which the Company is or was a participant and in which Mr. Ahuja has a material interest subject to disclosure under Item 404(a) of Regulation S-K. Offer Letter with Mr. Ahuja The Company entered into an offer letter with Mr. Ahuja, pursuant to which Mr. Ahuja will receive an annual base salary of $900,000 and an annual target bonus equal to 115% of his base salary. Annual Long-Term Incentive Awards. In March 2027, as part of the Company’s annual grant cycle and subject to approval by the Compensation and Talent Committee of the Board of Directors (the “ Committee ”), Mr. Ahuja will be eligible to receive annual long-term incentive awards under the QXO, Inc. 2024 Omnibus Incentive Compensation Plan (the “ Plan ”) in the form of (i) time-based restricted stock units (“ RSUs ”) with a grant-date value of $1,137,500 (“ 2027 RSUs ”) and (ii) performance-based restricted stock units (“ PSUs ”) with a grant-date value of $2,112,500 (the “ 2027 PSUs ”). Beginning in 2028, Mr. Ahuja will be eligible to receive subsequent long-term incentive awards as part of the Company’s normal annual grant cycle. The 2027 RSUs will vest over a period of four years, with 25% vesting on each of the first four anniversaries of the grant date, subject to Mr. Ahuja’s continued employment through the applicable vesting date. The 2027 PSUs will be earned based on the Company’s total stockholder return relative to companies in the S&P 500 Index over two performance periods, with (i) 50% of the target 2027 PSUs measured over the performance period from January 1, 2027 through December 31, 2028 and (ii) 50% of the 2027 PSUs measured over the performance period from January 1, 2029 through December 31, 2030. Earned 2027 PSUs may range from 0% to 225% of target, and any earned 2027 PSUs would vest on the last day of the applicable performance period, subject to the Committee’s certification of achievement of the applicable performance target and Mr. Ahuja’s continued employment through the vesting date. All shares received upon settlement of the 2027 RSUs and 2027 PSUs will be subject to a restriction on sales, offers, pledges, transfers and dispositions for one year after such shares vest. Equity Sign-On Award . In March 2027, as part of the Company’s annual grant cycle and subject to Committee approval, Mr. Ahuja will receive an equity sign-on award consisting of RSUs with a grant-date value of $4,500,000 (“ Sign-On RSUs ”) under the Plan. The Sign-On RSUs will vest over four years, with 25% vesting on each of the first four anniversaries of the grant date, subject to Mr. Ahuja’s continued employment through the applicable vesting date. All shares received upon settlement of the Sign-On RSUs will be subject to a restriction on sales, offers, pledges, transfers and other dispositions until the first anniversary of the date on which such shares vest. Relocation Incentive Award . On his start date, subject to Committee approval, Mr. Ahuja will also receive an equity incentive award consisting of RSUs with a grant-date value of $150,000 (“ Relocation RSUs ”) under the Plan. The Relocation RSUs will vest in full on the one-month anniversary of the grant date, subject to Mr. Ahuja’s continued employment through such vesting date. If Mr. Ahuja’s employment terminates for any reason other than an involuntary termination without cause on or after the vesting date but prior to the second anniversary of his start date, he will be required to repay the fair market value of the Relocation RSUs as of the vesting date, less any taxes withheld or paid in connection with the vesting of the Relocation RSUs. New Hire Incentive Award . On his start date, subject to Committee approval, Mr. Ahuja will also receive an equity incentive award consisting of RSUs with a grant-date value of $1,151,570 (“ New Hire RSUs ”) under the Plan. The New Hire RSUs will vest in full on the one-month anniversary of the grant date, subject to Mr. Ahuja’s continued employment through such vesting date. If Mr. Ahuja’s employment terminates for any reason other than an involuntary termination without cause on or after the vesting date but prior to the second anniversary of his start date, he will be required to repay the fair market value of the New Hire RSUs as of the vesting date, less any taxes withheld or paid in connection with the vesting of the New Hire RSUs. Mr. Ahuja’s employment is expressly conditioned on his relocation to Greenwich, Connecticut and the Company will cover reasonable commuting or temporary housing expenses until he relocates. Mr. Ahuja will also enter into the Company’s Confidential Information Protection Agreement and will be eligible to participate in the Company’s Severance Plan, as in effect from time to time, which provides severance benefits upon certain qualifying terminations of employment. The foregoing summary of the offer letter does not purport to be complete and is subject to, and qualified in its entirety by, the full text of the offer letter, a copy of which will be filed as an exhibit to the Company’s Annual Report on Form 10-K for the year ending December 31, 2026.
